description: A high-performance component for rendering large, flat lists of data efficiently using lazy loading and windowing.

flatListVsScrollView.FlatList: Optimized for large datasets with lazy rendering and better memory usage.
flatListVsScrollView.ScrollView: Renders all children at once and is not suitable for long lists.

data.name: data
data.description: Array of items to be rendered in the list.

data.name: renderItem
data.description: Function that renders each item in the list.

data.name: keyExtractor
data.description: Extracts a unique key for each list item.

data.name: extraData
data.description: Forces FlatList to re-render when external state changes.

data.name: horizontal
data.description: Displays list items horizontally instead of vertically.

data.name: numColumns
data.description: Renders items in multiple columns (vertical only).

data.name: columnWrapperStyle
data.description: Styles the row wrapper when using multiple columns.

data.name: ListHeaderComponent
data.description: Component rendered at the top of the list.

data.name: ListFooterComponent
data.description: Component rendered at the bottom of the list.

data.name: ListEmptyComponent
data.description: Component rendered when data is empty.

data.name: onEndReached
data.description: Called when the end of the list is reached (infinite scroll).

data.name: getItemLayout
data.description: Optimizes scrolling by providing fixed item dimensions.

data.name: removeClippedSubviews
data.description: Improves performance by removing offscreen items.

data.name: onViewableItemsChanged
data.description: Called when list item visibility changes.

data.name: viewabilityConfig
data.description: Controls when items are considered visible.

methods.name: scrollToIndex
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific item index.

methods.name: scrollToOffset
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific pixel offset.

methods.name: scrollToEnd
methods.description: Scrolls to the end of the list.

example.title: Basic FlatList Example
example.description: A simple vertical list rendering text items.
